evidence: Analysis run on Databricks (data loaded into workspace.mlpab044ac1.training_data via a UC volume and queried through the SQL warehouse). f5 has Pearson correlation 0.9932 with the label, vs 0.08-0.15 for f1-f4,f6. Class-conditional stats show the two classes are completely non-overlapping on f5: label=0 spans [-0.428, 0.398] (mean 0.007) while label=1 spans [2.064, 2.833] (mean 2.496). A single threshold f5>1.0 classifies all 800/800 rows correctly (100% accuracy), which is impossible for a legitimate feature -- the hallmark of label leakage (f5 was computed from post-outcome data).
